hero.eyebrow: Behavioural assessment · Capability insights · Development pathways
hero.headline: Measure what a CV can't.
hero.subhead: Ignio is a behavioural-assessment platform that measures the human capabilities behind performance — how people act under uncertainty, pressure, and change.

problem.title: Potential is everywhere. Understanding it isn't.
problem.body1: A CV lists what someone knows. It says nothing about how they behave when a plan falls apart, a client says no, or a decision has to be made without enough information.
problem.body2: The real barriers to entrepreneurial success are often psychological and social — confidence, a sense of legitimacy, a scarcity mindset, the ability to collaborate, how someone makes decisions under pressure. They're rarely discussed, and almost never measured.

solution.title: A simple loop: assess, analyse, develop, measure.

trackRecord.title: Built on four years of real work, not theory
trackRecord.intro: Before Ignio was a platform, it was four years of direct work with migrant entrepreneurs in London.

entrepreneurs.label: Entrepreneurs reached across two programme editions

satisfaction.label: Rated the 2025 programme 9–10/10 likely to recommend

fieldToTech.title: Built from practice, not assumption
fieldToTech.body1: For four years, our team worked directly with Spanish-speaking migrant entrepreneurs in London — through Mesa de Emprendimiento and, later, structured programme cycles.
fieldToTech.body2: The same behavioural patterns kept showing up: confidence under uncertainty, resilience through setbacks, difficulty building trust, hesitation to lead without a formal title. We built a structured assessment to name and measure them properly.
fieldToTech.body3: That assessment became a digital profile, and the profile became Ignio — a platform built from what we actually saw happen, not from a generic soft-skills framework.
